title: 3D Scene Assertion Verification
claim: Ambiguous generative answers fail in decision settings; a binary assertion-verification task, diagnostic benchmark, and method together give better, verifiable accuracy.
layout: 3 panels left-to-right: task failure, task examples, benchmark/method/results bar chart
description: A wide figure split into three rounded, gray-titled panels. The left panel, "Descriptive 3D VQA", shows a 3D room scan with a question bubble, "Is the door locked?". Below it are vague red dashed-box answers and a red "Decision Ambiguity" label. The middle panel, "3D Scene Assertion Verification", has two cases, spatial relation and negation & quantity. Each case has a green assertion speech bubble, a scene render with colored bounding boxes and object-ID tags, and a "Prediction: YES" box. The right panel, "3DSAV Benchmark & DualLPSS Method", has a row of six chevrons for the semantic types with icons, a dataset-statistics line, and a simplified two-branch routing diagram that feeds a fusion block and then a truth judgment. Beside them is a bar chart in which the green "Ours" bar, 82.55%, is taller than the red baseline, 80.53%.
caption: Overview of the proposed task, benchmark, and method. (Left) We introduce the task of 3D Scene Assertion Verification. (Middle) We construct 3DSAV, the first large-scale diagnostic benchmark. (Right) Our DualLPSS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.
abstract: Existing 3D Visual Question Answering (3D-VQA) methods rely on generative outputs that can be ambiguous in decision-making settings. We introduce 3D Scene Assertion Verification, a task that verifies natural language assertions in 3D scenes with strict binary judgments. We present 3DSAV, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark with 22.5k samples across six semantic types. To address this task, we propose DualLPSS, which uses dual-stage subspace routing for type-aware cross-modal fusion and scene-guided assertion focusing. Experiments show that DualLPSS achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3DSAV and handles complex logical assertions better than existing 3D-VQA baselines.
